correctness.rationale: Direct Jacobian reconstruction gives a recovered eigenvalue −mu and quartic tau determinant (lambda^2+A lambda+C)(lambda+b)(1+tau lambda)+D. Every coefficient and Delta2 are positive; Delta3 factors into a strictly positive multiple of K(tau)−D. Quartic Routh sign changes give exact unstable index 2 when negative, and equality factors a simple imaginary conjugate pair with a stable remaining quadratic. The log derivative of K has cubic numerator H with exactly one positive root by Descartes and endpoint signs; K diverges linearly as tau increases. The full positive endemic witness exactly satisfies all nonlinear equations, with exact rational two-crossing sign brackets. A packaged SymPy checker independently verifies the nonstandard algebra and rational substitutions.

value.rationale: The motivating paper explicitly leaves possible finite-delay Hopf behavior for future study and analyzes only zero/small delay. The theorem supplies a complete and parameter-explicit all-delay map for its exact two-stage information dynamics, proves no more than one instability window is possible, and gives a concrete admissible model with local stability lost and regained as mean reporting delay changes. The conclusion is useful even without a periodic-orbit theorem, because policymakers cannot infer intermediate-delay stability from stable short- and long-delay regimes. It is a motivated structural classification, not an arbitrary parameter slice or restatement of the known one-filter phenomenon.
